periods.description: A high-level Kirihime assassination sword technique that reads the instant an opponent's consciousness opens and strikes during that gap. In vol-21 Yatoro adapts it into feints, stealth movement and close-range surprise attacks, while Lux later imitates its principle in battle.

activation.condition: opponent exposes a mental or tactical gap

known_feats: Yatoro nearly defeats Lux despite his Baptism-enhanced senses.
Lux later defeats the Hounds leader by reading the opponent and striking from behind.
